approval_record.response: I also approve this and it should be pushed.
approval_record.approved_scope: Repository publication of the Daily Market Dashboard surface, removal of observed-day homepage messaging, removal of public index emphasis, and monthly plotting for ranges longer than 30 days. Production deployment remains separately locked.

scope.declared_roster: products present in the separately approved factual-offer payload
public_surfaces: source-linked daily low and high evidence

calculation.intraday_selection: latest qualifying observation per Europe/London calendar day, exact MPN and retailer
calculation.product_typical: median of one selected qualifying price per retailer
calculation.category_typical: median of per-product daily medians; one exact MPN receives one vote
calculation.gap_policy: no interpolation, forward-fill, backfill or line across an unobserved calendar day
calculation.range_anchor: latest retained qualifying observation date, never browser current date
calculation.monthly_point: rounded arithmetic average of the daily typical minor-unit prices retained in that Europe/London calendar month
calculation.monthly_gap_policy: no point for an unobserved month and no line across an unobserved month
calculation.monthly_range: no monthly low/high whisker; daily source evidence remains available in the price-history workspace

quality.note: Large but otherwise qualifying price movements are not silently removed. Further outlier rules require a separately reviewed policy revision.

allowed: low and high among retained qualifying observations
coverage against the released exact-product roster
direction versus the immediately preceding calendar day only when the same exact products are represented
